mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, the Chande-Kroll Dynamic Momentum Index returning inside its conventional 30/70 envelope adapts close-to-close momentum memory inversely to current volatility and marks an extreme beginning to normalize; follow the inward direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when DYMI crosses strictly above 30 after being at or below 30; short when it crosses strictly below 70 after being at or above 70
mechanism.why_distinct: DYMI is a variable-length close-to-close RSI. Its current period is int(14 divided by the ratio of five-bar close standard deviation to its ten-observation average), bounded to 5..30. It is not fixed Wilder RSI, Relative Volatility Index, IMI candle bodies, fitted threshold, OI, flow, volume, funding, reused event, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: both its oscillator memory and the separate completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized-variation gate respond causally to July-like volatility
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse adaptive-memory four-hour re-entry clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.dynamic_period: sample std of latest 5 completed closes divided by simple mean of latest 10 such std values; int(14/ratio), clipped 5..30
features.dynamic_rsi: 100*sum positive close changes over the current dynamic period divided by sum positive plus absolute negative changes over that same period; zero denominator invalid
features.reentry: current DYMI strictly crosses inward through 30 or 70 from immediately prior valid DYMI
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published volatility-adaptive RSI re-entry under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no volatility ratio, period conversion or bounds, RSI formula, level, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.origin: Tushar Chande and Stanley Kroll, Dynamic Momentum Index
external_basis.fixed_definition: StdC5=sample standard deviation of five completed closes; StdA=ten-period simple average of StdC5; Vi=StdC5/StdA; TD=int(14/Vi) truncated toward zero and bounded to 5..30; RSI-style sums over current TD; conventional 30/70 envelope re-entry
external_basis.selection_use: published volatility ratio, variable-period bounds, RSI construction, levels, and inward direction only; no incidence or outcomes
